alignment.external_graph_prior: proposed but unsupported in executable approximation

db_pcpd_postmortem.lesson: The proposal borrowed broad biological-structure language but did not transfer the coupled Lingshu generative mechanism. Future proposals need mechanism-alignment scoring before selection.

example_research_questions: Can a condition-aware generative model better use target-to-gene priors than the current deterministic backbone?
Does classifier-free guidance improve perturbation signal after a clean target-specific prior is available?
Can the model separately represent H1 global context and target-specific residual?

historical_evidence.autonomous_skill_v1: DB-PCPD-inspired graph-delta candidate reached Pearson-Delta 0.042183; broad biological-structure wording was insufficient to transfer Lingshu mechanisms.
historical_evidence.autonomous_skill_v2: Minimal masked-generative candidate reached Pearson-Delta 0.0000699; surface-level raw token, mask, condition, and CFG mechanisms did not create target-specific perturbation learning.

autonomous_skill_v6_gfect.failure_lesson: The main official trial used shuffled_target_control=true, so it evaluated a negative-control behavior rather than the primary learned target-to-effect mechanism.
autonomous_skill_v6_gfect.finding: GFECT improved over prior autonomous Lingshu-skill candidates but remains far below Lingshu reference.
autonomous_skill_v6_gfect.next_implication: Separate primary candidate from falsification controls; do not merely tune GFECT scalars; consider stronger target-to-gene signal, perturbation-conditioned objective, gene-position conditioning, generation/sampling, or model-family change.

autonomous_skill_v7_ps_de_vae.failure_lesson: Control-only regulatory profiles describe baseline co-expression, not intervention-aware target-to-gene perturbation effects. Model sophistication cannot compensate for missing target-specific perturbation signal.
autonomous_skill_v7_ps_de_vae.finding: A richer VAE/contrastive/FiLM/gene-position decoder did not improve when its target-specific signal came only from control-derived co-expression/regulatory profiles.
autonomous_skill_v7_ps_de_vae.next_implication: Avoid another control-coexpression or PS-DE-VAE dimensional tweak; choose a materially different direction or add a genuinely intervention-aware target-to-gene signal and objective.

historical_evidence.binary_lingshu_clue: failed as isolated component ablation only
historical_evidence.cm4ai_direction: highest-priority provenance-safe target-to-gene prior pending controlled validation
historical_evidence.current_reliable_representation: 150-target H1 global prior + small external GWPS residual correction

insights.minimal_experiment: Compare a small condition-aware generative objective with deterministic pseudobulk prediction under the same VCC25 validation protocol.
insights.risks: May overfit weak target identity signals; needs strict split and leakage controls.
insights.solves: Allows full expression profiles to be generated under explicit perturbation conditions.
insights.suitable_data: Single-cell count data with target/cell/batch condition metadata and official gene ordering.
insights.why_worth_considering: The task has cell-level heterogeneity and large target-specific residuals that are poorly represented by a deterministic target mean alone.

insights.minimal_experiment: Change only the condition representation and compare against shuffled-target and no-condition controls.
insights.risks: Generic target identity is insufficient for unseen target residual if no target-to-gene biology is available.
insights.solves: Reduces ambiguity between observed state and perturbation intent.
insights.suitable_data: Datasets with reliable target_gene, cell_type, control, and batch metadata.
insights.why_worth_considering: Separating condition from expression can expose target and context information without collapsing them into target mean deltas.

insights.minimal_experiment: Full-gene representation versus compact representation with identical split, seeds, and evaluator.
insights.risks: Noise and compute can dominate if target-specific signal is weak.
insights.solves: Preserves gene-specific response and makes the official 18,080-gene output a native modeling object.
insights.suitable_data: Tasks with fixed full-gene panel and enough compute for high-dimensional modeling.
insights.why_worth_considering: Perturbation effects can appear outside HVG-selected or low-dimensional summary features.

insights.idea: Masked discrete diffusion or masked generative modeling
insights.minimal_experiment: A small masked-token baseline with documented tokenizer contract and finite-loss smoke before any H200 scale-up, plus an explicit perturbation-conditioned objective and shuffled-target/no-condition negative control.
insights.risks: Original Lingshu training workflow is missing; a new implementation must be reported as a new model family, not as Lingshu reproduction. A reconstruction-only objective or train-count-profile predictor is a known failure mode.
insights.solves: Avoids treating every gene response as independent regression.
insights.suitable_data: Raw or discretized expression representation with stable tokenizer vocabulary.
insights.why_worth_considering: Masked-token objectives can model gene-gene dependence and support conditional generation.

insights.minimal_experiment: Guidance on/off with fixed model and shuffled-condition negative control.
insights.risks: Can distort response amplitude or DE direction if guidance scale is not validation-calibrated. Formal CFG syntax is not meaningful unless conditional and neutral paths differ through learned perturbation signal.
insights.solves: Tests whether condition signal is usable at inference time.
insights.suitable_data: Generative models with conditional and less-conditional training/inference paths.
insights.why_worth_considering: May amplify weak perturbation condition signal relative to global H1 context.

insights.minimal_experiment: Add or replace exactly one target-specific prior source while keeping H1 global prior, split, seeds, model, and evaluator fixed.
insights.risks: Leakage, context mismatch, and confounding if multiple priors change at once.
insights.solves: Supplies target-to-affected-gene structure unavailable from target identity.
insights.suitable_data: Provenance-safe signed target-to-gene perturbation signatures or regulatory priors.
insights.why_worth_considering: Current target-specific residual is not identifiable from GO or generic embeddings alone.

masked_gen_v2_postmortem.lesson: Surface implementation of raw-count tokens, masks, condition labels, and CFG is insufficient. The next proposal must specify how target-conditioned perturbation response is learned or sampled.

mechanism_alignment_checklist.approximation_gap: Which Lingshu mechanisms are missing and why might the candidate still inherit useful behavior?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.biological_prior: Is any target-to-gene prior provenance-safe and gene-position-specific?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.cfg_or_control_contrast: Does inference use conditional vs neutral-control contrast, or is CFG absent?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.count_token_contract: Does it use raw-count tokens, a documented tokenizer, or a clearly different continuous contract?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.evidence: Which VCC25 historical evidence supports the mechanism, and what negative control can falsify it?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.generative_objective: Does it include conditional generation/masked-token modeling, or only regression?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.target_specific_conditioning: What target/cell/control condition is used and where does it enter?
mechanism_alignment_checklist.whole_transcriptome: Does the proposal preserve audited 18,080 gene positions?

mechanism_attribution: whole-transcriptome modeling over the full gene panel
classifier-free guidance comparing target-conditioned and neutral-control paths
sequence compression / long-sequence handling for whole-gene transformers
purpose: Provide transferable Lingshu-Cell model design insights for autonomous VCC25 H1 hypothesis generation without requiring a Lingshu implementation.

skill_v3_core_mechanism_requirement.central_mechanism: control/context expression + perturbation target condition + target-specific gene-level signal when available -> learn or sample perturbed whole-transcriptome expression

convergence_target.meaning: Approximately 80 percent of Lingshu reference, used as research convergence target rather than promotion gate.

must_specify: approximation gap from Lingshu reference mechanisms

skill_v4_proposal_to_implementation_inte.failure_mode: Heuresis implementation request collapsed the new mechanism into a patch on Candidate G/R with a DE-gene mask.
implementation_requirements: Create a new standalone candidate identity and runner for a novel proposal.
Do not modify Candidate G/R or Candidate R-specific files as the primary implementation for a novel proposal.
Use shared task infrastructure only as infrastructure, not as model reuse.

The formal VCC25 execution baseline now provides a generic autonomous candidate route. New proposals should use candidate_variant = autonomous_research_candidate and candidate-local allowed_paths only. Do not include tasks/vcc25/official_h1_adapter.py, controller_bash/scripts/task_contract.py, or controller_bash/scripts/run_trials.py unless the user explicitly reopens execution-layer work.
If a historical component is agent-selected, label it explicitly and state the approximation gap.
Stop with an unsupported-component blocker rather than silently falling back to historical candidate routes.
skill_v4_proposal_to_implementation_inte.lesson: A mechanism-level Skill can improve proposal quality, but the implementation request must preserve standalone autonomous candidate identity instead of projecting the idea onto historical candidate-specific code.

skill_v5_target_specific_signal_lesson.main_lesson: Target identity tokens, random stable target hashes, and generic labels are not target-specific biological information. They can name an unseen target but do not say which genes or pathways that target should affect.
requirements_for_next_proposals: Do not spend another iteration on small DSACT-style transport tweaks unless the proposal adds a materially different target-specific signal or a materially different objective.

If target conditioning is used, specify the inference-available signal: target-to-gene prior, regulatory or pathway neighborhood, provenance-safe perturbation signature, raw-count condition-token mechanism, or another concrete biological source.
If no new biological signal is used, explain why the objective can generalize target-specific effects to unseen targets rather than memorizing training target labels.

Actively consider a different model family, representation, training objective, conditioning path, generation process, or biological information source when the current family remains near zero Pearson-Delta.

skill_v6_proposal_collision_lesson.main_lesson: Co-expression or gene geometry may describe baseline cellular structure, but perturbation prediction needs a mechanism for how target intervention changes gene expression.
skill_v6_proposal_collision_lesson.observed_candidate: Control-Derived Co-Expression Gated Perturbation Delta Predictor
skill_v6_proposal_collision_lesson.reason: The selected idea was too close to an existing control-derived co-expression / gene-geometry residual-flow family, and naive co-expression was judged to capture stable baseline relationships rather than intervention-specific target effects.
requirements_for_next_proposals: Do not treat raw control co-expression around a target gene as sufficient target-specific perturbation information.
If structural context is used, distinguish baseline correlation from intervention effect.
If claiming Lingshu inheritance, identify where target-specific perturbation signal enters the objective, conditioning path, sampling path, or output residual.
Avoid minor tweaks of the abandoned co-expression-gated delta family unless the proposal adds a materially different intervention-aware signal or a new model family/objective.

gfect.reason: The successful official run used shuffled_target_control=true, so it is not the normal primary best.

ps_de_vae.lesson: A more complex latent/generative architecture did not help because its conditioning was still control-derived rather than intervention-aware.

iffm.lesson: No valid official score was produced; do not classify it as a model-performance failure.

skill_v9_intervention_fingerprint_direct.main_question: For each training perturbation target, what train-only target-to-gene intervention fingerprint can be estimated, denoised, reliability-weighted, and tested for cross-target accessibility?
mechanism_alignment_requirements: State whether the signal is learned from perturbation response, external target-to-gene evidence, or a train-only contrast.
Explain how validation/test leakage is avoided.
Explain how the signal affects gene-wise Delta prediction.
Include a negative control that tests whether the model uses the intervention signal rather than baseline expression reconstruction.
Explain why the mechanism is materially different from DB-PCPD, masked-gen, DSACT, GFECT, PS-DE-VAE, and IFFM.
skill_v9_intervention_fingerprint_direct.h200_gate: Only run official H200 after a lightweight data audit and candidate smoke confirm that the candidate is learning target-specific intervention response.
avoid_repeating: another VAE/flow/transformer whose conditioning is still only target ID
control-derived regulatory profiles without intervention contrast
using a shuffled negative control as the primary candidate behavior

usage_principles: Use Lingshu ideas as priors, not predetermined answers.
Allow ResearchStudio to adopt, modify, combine, or abandon each idea.
Require one-variable controlled experiments and negative controls before candidate promotion.
Do not inject Lingshu checkpoint, source implementation, clue CSV, or original training loop.
Require mechanism_alignment for proposals seeded by Lingshu Skills.
Do not use Lingshu reference Pearson-Delta as acceptance_criteria; use task-local validation gates instead.
If a proposal introduces graph/PPI reasoning, require evidence that it supplies target-specific gene effects rather than generic similarity.
If one or two iterations show no improvement, reassess representation, objective, conditioning, generation, biological signal, and model family instead of making small edits to the same architecture.
Use Lingshu reference Pearson-Delta around 0.24 only as a research convergence reference; do not use it as a hard proposal admission gate.
Before the next H200 scientific run, require ResearchStudio to identify or audit a target-specific intervention fingerprint instead of proposing another architecture-only variant.
